description: How ETFIQ computes a number, from the methodology page that says so: one page per desk (income, buffer, leverage, crypto, alternatives, themes), flows, scores, categories (how stock and bond funds are placed and which benchmark each is measured against), portfolio look-through, and the ETFIQ benchmarks for model portfolios. Pass topic, the reader's question in their words; the answer names the page, quotes the paragraphs that answer it and gives the page's text. A single fund's own benchmark follows its desk's rule (an income fund's is on the income page), never the model-portfolio benchmarks. Call with no topic for the list of pages.
